verse.unicode: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ

transliteration.english: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar chhayvaa asaTapadhee

en.bdb: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla, Sixth House, Ashtapadee:

verse.unicode: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥

transliteration.english: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||

en.bdb: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verse.unicode: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਇਓ ਤਿਹ ਤਿਹ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: jo jo joonee aaio teh teh urajhaio maanas janam sa(n)jog paiaa ||

en.bdb: Whoever is born into the world, is entangled in it; human birth is obtained only by good destiny.

verse.unicode: ਤਾਕੀ ਹੈ ਓਟ ਸਾਧ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: taakee hai oT saadh raakhahu dhe kar haath kar kirapaa melahu har raiaa ||1||

en.bdb: I look to Your support, O Holy Saint; give me Your hand, and protect me. By Your Grace, let me meet the Lord, my King. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: anik janam bhram thit nahee paiee ||

en.bdb: I wandered through countless incarnations, but I did not find stability anywhere.

verse.unicode: ਕਰਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਉ ਚਰਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜੀ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: karau sevaa gur laagau charan govi(n)dh jee kaa maarag dheh jee bataiee ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: I serve the Guru, and I fall at His feet, praying, ""O Dear Lord of the Universe, please, show me the way.""||1||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਬਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ ॥

transliteration.english: anik upaav karau maiaa kau bachit dharau meree meree karat sadh hee vihaavai ||

en.bdb: I have tried so many things to acquire the wealth of Maya, and to cherish it in my mind; I have passed my life constantly crying out, ""Mine, mine!""

verse.unicode: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਲਾਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਚਿੰਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: koiee aaiso re bheTai sa(n)t meree laahai sagal chi(n)t Thaakur siau meraa ra(n)g laavai ||2||

en.bdb: Is there any such Saint, who would meet with me, take away my anxiety, and lead me to enshrine love for my Lord and Master. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਪੜੇ ਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬੇਦ ਨਹ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਭੇਦ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਧੀਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਪੰਚਾ ॥

transliteration.english: paRe re sagal bedh neh chookai man bhedh ik khin na dheereh mere ghar ke pa(n)chaa ||

en.bdb: I have read all the Vedas, and yet the sense of separation in my mind still has not been removed; the five thieves of my house are not quieted, even for an instant.

verse.unicode: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਭਗਤੁ ਜੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਿੰਚਾ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: koiee aaiso re bhagatu ju maiaa te rahat ik a(n)mirat naam merai ridhai si(n)chaa ||3||

en.bdb: Is there any devotee, who is unattached to Maya, who may irrigate my mind with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the One Lord? ||3||

verse.unicode: ਜੇਤੇ ਰੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਏ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਏ ਘਰ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ॥

transliteration.english: jete re teerath naae aha(n)budh mail laae ghar ko Thaakur ik til na maanai ||

en.bdb: In spite of the many places of pilgrimage for people to bathe in, their minds are still stained by their stubborn ego; the Lord Master is not pleased by this at all.

verse.unicode: ਕਦਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੈ ॥੪॥

transliteration.english: kadh paavau saadhasa(n)g har har sadhaa aana(n)dh giaan a(n)jan meraa man isanaanai ||4||

en.bdb: When will I find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy? There, I shall be always in the ecstasy of the Lord, Har, Har, and my mind shall take its cleansing bath in the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom. ||4||

verse.unicode: ਸਗਲ ਅਸ੍ਰਮ ਕੀਨੇ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਨੇ ਬਿਬੇਕਹੀਨ ਦੇਹੀ ਧੋਏ ॥

transliteration.english: sagal asram keene manooaa neh pateene bibekaheen dhehee dhoe ||

en.bdb: I have followed the four stages of life, but my mind is not satisfied; I wash my body, but it is totally lacking in understanding.

verse.unicode: ਕੋਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਰੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਏ ॥੫॥

transliteration.english: koiee paieeaai re purakh bidhaataa paarabraham kai ra(n)g raataa mere man kee dhuramat mal khoe ||5||

en.bdb: If only I could meet some devotee of the Supreme Lord God, imbued with the Lord's Love, who could eradicate the filthy evil-mindedness from my mind. ||5||

verse.unicode: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਪੜੈ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥

transliteration.english: karam dharam jugataa nimakh na het karataa garab garab paRai kahee na lekhai ||

en.bdb: One who is attached to religious rituals, does not love the Lord, even for an instant; he is filled with pride, and he is of no account.

verse.unicode: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋਊ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਪੇਖੈ ॥੬॥

transliteration.english: jis bheTeeaai safal moorat karai sadhaa keerat gur parasaadh kouoo netrahu pekhai ||6||

en.bdb: One who meets with the rewarding personality of the Guru, continually sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. By Guru's Grace, such a rare one beholds the Lord with his eyes. ||6||

verse.unicode: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜੋ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਗੁਲ ਜਿਉ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੇ ਧਾਰੀ ॥

transliteration.english: manahaTh jo kamaavai til na lekhai paavai bagul jiau dhiaan laavai maiaa re dhaaree ||

en.bdb: One who acts through stubbornness is of no account at all; like a crane, he pretends to meditate, but he is still stuck in Maya.

verse.unicode: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੭॥

transliteration.english: koiee aaiso re sukheh dhaiee prabh kee kathaa sunaiee tis bheTe gat hoi hamaaree ||7||

en.bdb: Is there any such Giver of peace, who can recite to me the sermon of God? Meeting him, I would be emancipated. ||7||

verse.unicode: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਕਾਟੈ ਰੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥

transliteration.english: suprasa(n)n gopaal rai kaaTai re ba(n)dhan mai gur kai sabadh meraa man raataa ||

en.bdb: When the Lord, my King, is totally pleased with me, He will break the bonds of Maya for me; my mind is imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verse.unicode: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੮॥

transliteration.english: sadhaa sadhaa aana(n)dh bheTio nirabhai gobi(n)dh sukh naanak laadhe har charan paraataa ||8||

en.bdb: I am in ecstasy, forever and ever, meeting the Fearless Lord, the Lord of the Universe. Falling at the Lord's Feet, Nanak has found peace. ||8||

verse.unicode: ਸਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਭਈ ਸਫਲ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ॥

transliteration.english: safal safal bhiee safal jaatraa ||

en.bdb: My Yatra, my life pilgrimage, has become fruitful, fruitful, fruitful.

verse.unicode: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੩॥

transliteration.english: aavan jaan rahe mile saadhaa ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||1||3||

en.bdb: My comings and goings have ended, since I met the Holy Saint. ||1||Second Pause||1||3||
